```{r, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning=FALSE)
# plotly.js from the CDN, so the site's pages don't each copy it
options(plotly.core.plotlyjs = "cdn")
```
#### Heatmap from an Image

The WebGL `heatmapgl` trace was removed from plotly.js; the regular heatmap
trace (`add_heatmap()`) handles large images well.

```{r}
library(jpeg)
library(plotly.core)

# Image processing
url <- "https://images.plot.ly/plotly-documentation/images/heatmap-galaxy.jpg"
tmpf <- tempfile()
download.file(url, tmpf, mode = "wb")
data <- readJPEG(tmpf)
fr <- file.remove(tmpf) # remove the downloaded temp file

zdata <- rowSums(data * 255, dims = 2)

go_figure() |>
  add_heatmap(
    z = zdata,
    colorscale = c("blue", "white", "red")
  )
```

#### Reference

See `go_heatmap()` for more information and options!
